en: In Proverbs 16, the Lord made every weight in which container?
In Proverbs 17, which companion stays true at all times?
In Proverbs 17, besides gold, which metal is tested by fire?
In Proverbs 18, the rich imagine their wealth is a high what?
In Proverbs 20, which drink, like strong drink, makes no one wise?
In Proverbs 20, who belittles the goods, then goes off boasting?
In Proverbs 21, the Lord directs the king's heart like streams of what?
In Proverbs 21, a wise man conquers which place of the mighty?
In Proverbs 22, a man skilled in his work will stand before whom?
In Proverbs 23, what should a glutton put to his throat?
In Proverbs 23, drowsiness clothes a person in what?
In Proverbs 24, which plot of the senseless man was overgrown with thorns?
In Proverbs 25, trusting the faithless is like which decayed body part?
In Proverbs 26, a fool's proverb is like what in a drunkard's hand?
In Proverbs 29, a flatterer spreads which hunting tool for his neighbor's feet?
In Proverbs 29, scoffers disturb which place, while the wise calm anger?
In Proverbs 30, which insects have no king yet advance in ranks?
In Proverbs 30, which creature has two greedy daughters demanding more?
In Proverbs 31, along with charm, what is worthless compared to fearing the Lord?
